retired.question: Every Mysterious Being in One-Punch Man?
retired.reason: Set version: the declared Mysterious Beings roster (207 members) is a category superset of the page's own listings -- it includes webcomic-only beings (Magnesauza, Meda, Pushu, Salany, Slice, Eguro, Nicopeen, Dress, Goddess Glasses, Gale, Hellfire, and more) and structural pages (Mysterious Beings, Characters, Characters (webcomic)), while the page's disaster-level lists name 173 manga and 25 webcomic beings. Strict set equality cannot be gilded. Kept as presence fact opm-pg-mysterious_beings-072 (168 resolvable names from the manga lists, with aliases, all present in the returned roster).

retired.question: Every Dragon level Mysterious Being in One-Punch Man?
retired.reason: Set version: this phrasing routes to the declared Mysterious Beings roster -- the match phrase 'mysterious being' out-bids 'dragon level' -- and even the correctly routed 45-member 'Dragon Level Monsters' roster (reachable via the 'Dragon level monster' phrasing) contains 11 members the wiki's 34-name Dragon list does not include (Apex Rabbit, Body, Dark Matter Thieves, Mastiking, Meteor, Ray, Shunpo, Tech, The Enhanced Monster Squad, Withered Sprout, plus the structural 'Mysterious Beings' page). Strict set equality cannot be gilded. Kept as presence fact opm-pg-mysterious_beings-073 (all 34 Dragon-list names present in the level roster).

retired.question: Every Demon level Mysterious Being in One-Punch Man?
retired.reason: Set version: this phrasing routes to the declared Mysterious Beings roster (the match phrase 'mysterious being' out-bids 'demon level'), and the correctly routed 68-member 'Demon Level Monsters' roster (reachable via the 'Demon level monster' phrasing) contains 20 members the wiki's 48-name Demon list does not include (webcomic-only beings such as Bidon, Dress, Eguro, Gale, Goddess Glasses, Hellfire, Magnesauza, Meda, Slice, and the structural 'Mysterious Beings' page). Strict set equality cannot be gilded. Kept as presence fact opm-pg-mysterious_beings-074 (all 48 Demon-list names present in the level roster, 'Pureblood' aliased to 'Vampire (Pureblood)').

retired.question: Every member of the Monster Association
retired.reason: Set version: the declared Monster Association roster returns 67 members, 9 of which (Gale, Goddess Glasses, Golden Sperm, Gyoro Gyoro, Hellfire, Love Slaves, Mysterious Beings, Platinum Sperm, Poison Lizard Sisters) are not in the page's 65-name Members tabber, and 7 tabber names (Base B, Demolition John, Gyoffrey, Metal Knight Unit, Rosie, Smelly Lid Old Man, Special Moves Mile) are not members of the category, so the two sets cannot be equal. Kept as presence fact opm-pg-mysterious_beings-076 (58 resolvable names from the Members tabber, all present in the returned roster).

retired.question: What happened to the unnamed monsters that appeared in chapters which were later redrawn?
retired.reason: Engine gap: the Unnamed subpage's Removed section is gallery-dominated and its single prose line ('These monsters appeared in chapters which were later redrawn, with the final redraw excluding or replacing them') is not chunked into anything the qa or narrative paths serve -- the line is absent from the bundle under every phrasing probed, while the page's lead (opm-pg-mysterious_beings-097) is served fine. Left un-tuned per the campaign's no-.py rule.
